sentences.text:
No NOTE.
03. 14.08.2023 NJS, J  W.P.No.20109 of 2023  Heard Sri Posani Venkateswarlu, learned Senior  Counsel appearing for the petitioners.
Sri J. Ugra Narasimha, learned counsel representing  the 5th respondent seeks time to secure written instructions and file counter affidavit.

Learned Assistant Government Pleader for Land Acquisition placed a copy of the written instructions dated 09.08.2023 and drawn the attention of this Court to page - 88 of the material papers, wherein, the petitioners appears to have been filed their reply/objections with regard to acquisition of land in-question and sought for compensation @ Rs.1,00,000/- per cent and seeks time to file counter affidavit.

Learned Assistant Government Pleader also submits that the preliminary Notifications and Draft Declarations were approved and published in the manner prescribed for all the villages covered under the revised alignment/requisition and further submits that the District Collector, Srikakulam, has proposed to conduct District Level Negotiations Committee meeting on 16.08.2023 along with the ryots concerned for fixation of market value.

She also placed a copy of the Notification published in the Srikakulam District Gazette vide Rc.No.327/2022, G1, dated 31.03.2022, (P.T.O) exempting the application of Provisions of the Chapter-II and Chapter-III of the Land Acquisition Act, 2013, invoking the provisions under Section 10 (A) of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 (A.P. Amendment).

sentences.text: In the light of the above stated position, the contentions raised in the Writ Petition, with regard to the validity of the Notification dated 01.10.2022, would have to be considered on filing of the counter affidavits.

However, in view of the submission made by the learned Senior Counsel, this Court is inclined to permit the petitioners to raise objections, if any, with regard to the Notification in-question by way of further objections, within a period of two days.

If such objections are filed,
respondent Nos.2 and 3 shall consider the same before taking a decision with regard to fixation of market value.

opennyai_summary.decision:
Learned Assistant Government Pleader for Land Acquisition placed a copy of the written instructions dated 09.08.2023 and drawn the attention of this Court to page - 88 of the material papers, wherein, the petitioners appears to have been filed their reply/objections with regard to acquisition of land in-question and sought for compensation @ Rs.1,00,000/- per cent and seeks time to file counter affidavit.
She also placed a copy of the Notification published in the Srikakulam District Gazette vide Rc.No.327/2022, G1, dated 31.03.2022, (P.T.O) exempting the application of Provisions of the Chapter-II and Chapter-III of the Land Acquisition Act, 2013, invoking the provisions under Section 10 (A) of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 (A.P. Amendment).
In the light of the above stated position, the contentions raised in the Writ Petition, with regard to the validity of the Notification dated 01.10.2022, would have to be considered on filing of the counter affidavits.
However, in view of the submission made by the learned Senior Counsel, this Court is inclined to permit the petitioners to raise objections, if any, with regard to the Notification in-question by way of further objections, within a period of two days.
If such objections are filed,
respondent Nos.2 and 3 shall consider the same before taking a decision with regard to fixation of market value.
